annotations.title: Find the municipality for a South African place

description: Turn a South African town, suburb or municipality name (e.g. "Hermanus", "Centurion", "Mossel Bay") into its municipality, province and district, and list which municipal by-laws GetLawED holds for it by topic, whether its land use / zoning scheme and planning by-law are held, and the council's own by-law page. Start here for any question about local rules (building, boundary walls, second dwellings, home businesses, signage, keeping animals, water, refuse, trading). Does not hold the zoning of individual erven.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code such as "WC043" or "CPT". Not a street address or erf number.
